profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at AppsGem
profile.summary: Computer Science Engineer with more than 15 years of experience as software developer, web developer and software designer among others responsibilities. Creation and delivery of releases for desktop and web environments. Able to work individually or as part of a team with developers, designers, analysts, marketing specialists, testers and other professionals. Able to work within companies standards and guidelines. Self-motivation and big growth expectations. Ability to learn new technologies and new ways to achieve the goals. Ability to develop projects from inception through production to final delivery. Highly skilled, good problem-solving and multi-tasking abilities, well organized, able to manage priorities and order tasks efficiently, a team worker with a positive attitude; a fast learner and hard worker.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and maintain React/jQuery interfaces with Bootstrap, focusing on performance and UX.
•	Build APIs and business logic in Laravel (PHP) integrated with MySQL.
•	Integrate REST APIs and optimize front–back data flows (fetching, caching, error handling).
•	Implement E2E testing with Cypress in CI/CD pipelines (regression coverage, critical paths).
•	Deliver responsive design and accessibility best practices across devices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	UI/FrontEnd using AngularJS, NodeJS, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery and Bootstrap.
•	Developed website using PHP, Wordpress CMS and MySQL.

positions.title: Web Development Consultant
positions.description:
Development and design of websites. 
•	UI/FrontEnd using AngularJS, Node.js, HTML5, CSS3 and GIT as the Version Control System.
•	Developed UT Cancun web page using PHP, WordPress CMS, HTML5, CSS3 and MySQL.
•	Working in many cases with Wordpress.
•	Communicating websites with social networks APIs and working on search engine rankings. SEO and SEM.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Development and maintenance of website.
•	UI/Front-end Developer using AngularJS,  HTML5, CSS3 and Bootstrap.
•	Coding new modules, maintaining and enhancing web.
•	Modifying layouts and master pages using HTML5, CSS3 and Bootstrap.
•	Coding client side functionalities using AngularJS.
•	Creating and modifying queries and stored procedures using MySQL.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Showing information in the presentation layer HTML, CSS, Bootstrap and jQuery as well as manipulating information using AJAX helpers.
•	Customizing processes using PHP.
•	Designing and implementing websites and data bases.
•	Specifying web sites requirements.
Development and maintenance of accounting system.
•	Implementing an accounting system using C# and SQL.
•	Creating and modifying views, queries and stored procedures using SQL Server and SQL Management Studio.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Member of a software team looking for solutions and giving technical support to the BPA, implementing strategies to meet with the requests presented.  Also I performed software engineering research, development and migration.
•	Programming controls and action methods for management systems using ASP.Net, C# and Entity Framework as ORM and other technologies to enhance the performance like jQuery, and AJAX helpers provided by .Net framework.
•	Provided project status to the Development Manager.
•	Participated in peer code reviews.
•	Using RazorPDF to facilitate users to obtain reports in PDF format.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Coded a lot of functionalities for an administration software and video catalogation.
•	Involved in various phases of Software Development Life Cycle of the application such as: Requirement, Analysis and Design, Test, Deployment.
•	Coded functions, model classes, and controllers.
•	Studied and decided the new technologies that were going to be used in the system.
•	Ability to develop projects from inception through production to final delivery.

educations.schoolName: Instituto Internacional Español de Marketing Digital - IIEMD

honors.title: Gold Diplome (Graduated Summa Cum Laude)
honors.description: A Gold Diplome is a "Summa Cum Laude" equivalent for cuban universities, given to students graduated with 4.75+ over 5 points.
honors.issuer: Issued by Universidad de las Ciencias Informáticas · Jul 2010
